BlackRock and Goldman Sachs Adjust Investment Strategies

BlackRock has shifted its investment strategy, becoming bullish on short-term bonds and downgrading its outlook on stocks. In contrast, Goldman Sachs has adopted a long position on both stocks and bonds.
